parts:
Opps, sorry, the R code is obviously wrong as this shouldn't be a histogram.

I have changed it to

<html>
 <body>
  <form action="helloworld1.html" method="POST">
   
    n : <input type="text" name="n" />  <br />
    mean: <input type="text" name="mean" />  <br />
    sd: <input type="text" name="sd" />  <br/>
   
    <input type="submit" value="GO !!" />
   
  </form>
 
  <img src="/opt/lampp/htdocs/brew/temp.png" >
   
  <%
    myN <- as.numeric(POST$n)
    myMean <- as.numeric(POST$mean)
    mySD <- as.numeric(POST$sd)
    stepsize <- 2*myN/10
    x <- seq(-myN, myN, stepsize)
    y <- dnorm(x, mean=myMean, sd=mySD)
   
    png(filename="/opt/lampp/htdocs/brew/temp.png")
     plot(x, y, type="l", col="red")
    dev.off()
   %>
       
 
 </body>
</html>

I run the codes in R (with myN, myMean, mySD being assigned values like 100, 0, 5, say) and it works and output a graph. But I am still getting error in Apache

error is "Error in seq.default(-myN, myN, stepsize) : 'from' must be of length 1"

What is wrong with the syntax? Please help! Thanks

On Wednesday, October 17, 2012 8:21:21 PM UTC-4, bernard wrote:
Hello,

I am trying to test my rapache installation with a simple brew script which should output a histogram, but it has not been successful. The script is very simple:


<html>
 <body>
  <form action="helloworld1.html" method="POST">
   
    n : <input type="text" name="n" />  <br />
    mean: <input type="text" name="mean" />  <br />
    sd: <input type="text" name="sd" />  <br/>
   
    <input type="submit" value="GO !!" />
   
  </form>
 
   
  <%
    myN <- as.numeric(POST$n)
    myMean <- as.numeric(POST$mean)
    mySD <- as.numeric(POST$sd)
    x <- rnorm(myN, myMean, mySD)

    png(filename="/opt/lampp/htdocs/brew/temp.png", width=500, height=500)
    hist(x, col="red")
    dev.off()

  %>
 
  <img src="/opt/lampp/htdocs/brew/temp.png" >

</body>
</html>
 
This is the error I got from apache's error log:

[Wed Oct 17 15:08:56 2012] [error] [client 127.0.0.1] rApache Notice!
Error in hist.default(x, col = "red") : invalid number of 'breaks'
Function brew returned an object of 'try-error'.
Loading required package: DBI
[Wed Oct 17 15:12:37 2012] [error] [client 127.0.0.1] rApache Notice!
Error in brew::brew(file = "/opt/lampp/htdocs/brew/tes2.html", envir = .rAenv) :
  No valid input


If the last three lines within <%, %> (from png .. to dev.offf()) and the corresponding line with the <img> tag are removed the script ran fine.  I am using Xampp for Linux on Ubuntu 11.04, the script is in /opt/lampp/htdocs/brew.

Please advise.

Thanks.

messages.author: dac343502ff19904
messages.subject: Re: error
parts:
You would be better off checking that your form values are non-NULL or give defaults if they are. 

As an alternative, you might be interested in the ex-manipulate.R example here http://www.math.csi.cuny.edu/gw/  
This takes care of the details for you, at the cost of being less flexible.
